generation_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE original transparent 2D environment prop sprite for a hand-painted abandoned mining industrial fantasy action game. Asset ID B01_crate_stack_v1.
Primary request: an attractive coherent staggered supply-crate stack, readable at 100–220 pixels in gameplay. The stack has three connected rectangular supply crates with unequal heights and a clear stepped silhouette: a broad steel-edged dark worn timber crate on the lower left, a lower olive canvas-covered crate toward front-right, and one smaller aged ivory canvas / timber crate set securely above the left rear. Practical mining hardware, restrained rivets, corner iron brackets, canvas binding straps, a few muted copper fittings. Everything feels built for an abandoned industrial mine.
Input images: Image 1 B01_floor_v1.png is ONLY a mood and material palette reference for the underground mining theme. Do NOT reproduce its floor or stones. Image 2 CH02_combat_v1.png is ONLY a hand-painted rendering / worn olive-and-ivory materials reference. Do NOT include a character or weapon.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. Solid fully opaque crate bodies with smooth clean alpha edges.
Composition/framing: single coherent centered stack; camera looking down approximately 55 degrees, low perspective top-down three-quarter gameplay view, orthographic-like, clearly visible crate tops and short front faces. Rectangular ground footprint; complete stack overall width-to-height around 1.4. All parts fully visible with generous transparent margins at least 12% on every edge. No disconnected extra props.
Style/medium: polished detailed hand-painted industrial fantasy, subtly painterly broad material surfaces, clear generous bevels, deliberate structural details readable when small, not photorealistic.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral overhead light from upper-left, quiet restrained ambient occlusion between crates. Moderate value separation from dark mining floor, no bloom.
Color palette: aged ivory, faded olive canvas, coal-black steel, gray-brown wood, muted rust. Restrained dark hardware and soft warm wood details; no saturated colors.
Text: none.
Constraints: entirely original object design. ONE requested sprite only, no sprite sheet, no comparison panel. No labels, letters, numbers, logos, markings, decals, emblems, UI, frame, checkerboard, floor, baseplate, pedestal, large cast shadow, debris field, luminous crystals, photographic treatment, excessive bright scratch noise. This must be clean standalone environment art for direct placement on the separately rendered game floor.
generation_history.review: Original coherent three-crate material language approved, but stack too tall, inadequate framing and one nonzero alpha edge pixel; refined using ImageGen.
